the evaluation of BP, anthropometric and metabolic indexes, as well as inflammatory markers, in young individuals stratifying them by their BP behavior in adolescence.
the relationship between BP and adipokines and inflammation, in order to identify the factors that are important in the development of atherosclerosis.

BP during adolescence is a predictor of BP and metabolic abnormalities in early adulthood.
